# Economy scenario suite v1 normative vectors.
# Native amounts are atomic units of the single native asset; seat sale
# amounts are USD cents. The scenarios are defined by
# docs/specifications/economy-scenario-suite-v1.md and generated by
# simulation/scenarios/. Every monetary total below is additionally derived
# in closed form from the Founder Constitution by
# tools/scenario-suite-vectors/expected.py, which imports nothing from
# simulation/.

# Native denomination, unchanged from founder-economy-manifest-v1.
denomination.decimal_places=8
denomination.atomic_units_per_display_unit=100000000
maximum_supply_atomic=5574394010000000000

# Scenario 1: a complete 731-cycle run over three staggered seats.
# Seat 1 and seat 2 both refer to seat 0. Seat k is inactive in cycle c when
# (c + 7k) mod 73 == 0; an inactive cycle reallocates the whole 342-unit
# Founder leg to seat (k + 1) mod 3 and creates the referral permission only
# when the cycle index is even.
economy.seats=3
economy.referred_seats=2
economy.cycles_per_seat=731
economy.inactive_period=73
economy.inactive_phase=7
economy.base_permission_total=57430000000
economy.referral_leg=1710000000

# The run and its digests.
economy.schema=protocol-stack/founder-economy-simulation-result/v1
economy.event_count=7308
economy.accepted_count=7303
economy.rejected_count=5
economy.events_digest=181232982137b4988d4c20dc4a4f8d0030278edc8ca10baae1fc7429dc61476e
economy.trace_digest=5efe577df652d0c8dc04a1ac4c44d452b4de57011bec79e7ea1319eb2033702e
economy.state_digest=afdabe7255fcdc731e27d08122bc0df602c538aa553066fd3afd455827991edc
economy.result_digest=6d60bbab7f75e69c81fe6279a15d46d89e35759326a7f36e8405fc9fd3f1da70

# Each channel's issued total. The Founder operator total is independent of
# inactivity: a reallocation changes the beneficiary of the 342-unit leg,
# never its amount. The referral total is 2 x 731 permissions less the ten
# whose supplied inactive-cycle decision withheld creation.
economy.channel.founder_operator=75000600000000
economy.channel.venture_escrow=37500300000000
economy.channel.community_grants_escrow=7500060000000
economy.channel.developer_incentives_escrow=3750030000000
economy.channel.system_creator_issuance_royalty=2193000000000
economy.channel.founder_referral=2482920000000
economy.issued_supply=128426910000000
economy.outstanding_permissions=0
economy.evaluated_permission_keys=3655
economy.referral_permissions_created=1452
economy.activated_seats=3
economy.pending_permissions=0
economy.supply_accounted=5574394010000000000

# Per-seat custody is that seat's own active legs plus every leg reallocated
# to it, and seat 0 additionally holds the whole referral channel. Custody
# must equal issued supply exactly.
economy.custody.founder_seat_00000=27448920000000
economy.custody.founder_seat_00001=25034400000000
economy.custody.founder_seat_00002=25000200000000
economy.custody.venture_escrow=37500300000000
economy.custody.community_grants_escrow=7500060000000
economy.custody.developer_incentives_escrow=3750030000000
economy.custody.system_creator_company=2193000000000
economy.custody_total=128426910000000

# The boundary probes, each still refused after 7,303 accepted events. The
# first is the exhaustion boundary: the issuance period ends at the 731st
# cycle and no later cycle exists.
economy.probe.cycle_beyond_window=CYCLE_RANGE
economy.probe.base_replay=REPLAY
economy.probe.exercise_replay=PERMISSION_NOT_FOUND
economy.probe.activation_replay=REPLAY
economy.probe.unreferred_referral=SEAT_NOT_REFERRED

# Every record's state digest chains to the next and to the final state.
economy.trace_digest_breaks=0

# Scenario 2: the maximally concentrated complete sale. The 100,000-seat
# capacity and the 1,000-seat per-principal bound meet at exactly 100
# principals, which is the smallest population that can absorb the capacity.
# The per-principal bound is not a per-human bound; nothing here shows that
# two principal identifiers are two people.
seats.schema=protocol-stack/founder-seat-schedule-result/v1
seats.event_count=100101
seats.accepted_count=100000
seats.rejected_count=101
seats.events_digest=b2e4a5dfc99aa0fe3746959b425fab6b1ae52354775eed88306869c388da77ab
seats.trace_digest=68feac9aa533fdf5843608af52c6cd976ed8f8d1de0eb2957286e098e1382707
seats.state_digest=e8aebb4d484e637ec761054d046e285076056018bfec08a0f38aae77e83a20e8
seats.result_digest=798541f1c6d630663b0b284fe560773d81a5f37a9d5ca6f8e60dd7aa27a00309
seats.capacity=100000
seats.maximum_per_principal=1000
seats.minimum_principals=100
seats.sold=100000
seats.remaining=0
seats.largest_principal_holding=1000
seats.proceeds_usd_cents=423185500000
seats.final_block_price_usd_cents=9190000
seats.over_limit_rejections=99
seats.probe.beyond_capacity=CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED
seats.probe.purchase_replay=REPLAY

# Scenario 3: a 122-cycle routing run whose active population changes every
# cycle. Twenty-five cycles are empty; each carries its whole pool forward
# and burns nothing. The run ends one cycle after an empty cycle, so the
# recorded state holds value an empty cycle carried and a later cycle paid.
routing.schema=protocol-stack/revenue-routing-result/v1
routing.event_count=369
routing.accepted_count=366
routing.rejected_count=3
routing.events_digest=d2a0cedb6a6ed93313045dd7c827fab7a35cd83e87685933bb30df9b081a9154
routing.trace_digest=65759f11ef5d5ebed6188fb90fae18cbbc9ea896ff1780807bb04594f0692b95
routing.state_digest=339f52acaf1bb0ca01465227b07e664a1526f20baf970f4ef55c804bc5b777ac
routing.result_digest=0a13e59db8e59e4caf56f0c574daad2fdf47dd2ef5a22c066a133ff95d88bfb7
routing.cycles=122
routing.cycles_closed=122
routing.empty_cycles=25
routing.commercial_routed_total=129380875377
routing.fee_routed_total=61716323
routing.system_creator_balance=12938087483
routing.commercial_pool=0
routing.fee_pool=0
routing.commercial_carry=1
routing.fee_carry=0
routing.creator_count=2
routing.credited_seats=91

# Both conservation equations, summed from the recorded balances rather than
# read from a metric.
routing.conservation.commercial=129380875377
routing.conservation.fee=61716323

# The routing boundary probes.
routing.probe.payment_replay=REPLAY
routing.probe.close_wrong_cycle=CYCLE_MISMATCH
routing.probe.close_stale_snapshot=INVALID_RESEARCH_INPUT

# Scenario 4: every envelope exhausted and every escrow drained, bound to
# scenario 1's final state. The bound digest is that run's own state digest,
# so the escrows are drained of exactly what three seats issued into them
# across their complete 731-cycle windows.
escrow.bound_state_digest=afdabe7255fcdc731e27d08122bc0df602c538aa553066fd3afd455827991edc
escrow.schema=protocol-stack/escrow-payout-result/v1
escrow.event_count=34
escrow.accepted_count=28
escrow.rejected_count=6
escrow.events_digest=bcff3941a6e0d376ea932584be9c75e0e8aa9ce5ad19b5231532e8f59f10ce49

escrow.result_digest=7b52c895c71237338ace91337b2a2477ccd5b4e9ee903d70a3d90aa8cead2b91
escrow.payouts_per_escrow=7
escrow.capability_count=6
escrow.accepted_payouts=21
escrow.exhausted_envelopes=3

# Each escrow's opening, drain, and recipients. Seven payouts divide none of
# the three openings evenly, so each escrow's last payout is a remainder.
escrow0.opening_custody=37500300000000
escrow0.available_custody=0
escrow0.paid_out_total=37500300000000
escrow0.payout_count=7
escrow0.recipient_count=3
escrow1.opening_custody=7500060000000
escrow1.available_custody=0
escrow1.paid_out_total=7500060000000
escrow1.payout_count=7
escrow1.recipient_count=3
escrow2.opening_custody=3750030000000
escrow2.available_custody=0
escrow2.paid_out_total=3750030000000
escrow2.payout_count=7
escrow2.recipient_count=3

# Three equations per escrow that share no term: opening equals available
# plus paid out, paid out equals the credited recipients, and paid out equals
# the charged capability envelopes.
escrow0.conservation.held=37500300000000
escrow0.conservation.credited=37500300000000
escrow0.conservation.charged=37500300000000
escrow1.conservation.held=7500060000000
escrow1.conservation.credited=7500060000000
escrow1.conservation.charged=7500060000000
escrow2.conservation.held=3750030000000
escrow2.conservation.credited=3750030000000
escrow2.conservation.charged=3750030000000

# Exhausted delegated authority and an emptied escrow report differently.
# The envelope check precedes the custody check, so the second probe needs a
# freshly granted capability with authority to spare.
escrow0.probe.envelope=ENVELOPE_EXCEEDED
escrow0.probe.custody=INSUFFICIENT_CUSTODY
escrow1.probe.envelope=ENVELOPE_EXCEEDED
escrow1.probe.custody=INSUFFICIENT_CUSTODY
escrow2.probe.envelope=ENVELOPE_EXCEEDED
escrow2.probe.custody=INSUFFICIENT_CUSTODY
